messages:
Aisha (PM): Heads-up — final GA runway tomorrow. Need to lock SLA numbers, support routing/runbooks, monitoring thresholds, docs smoke tests, and pricing tiers. Who owns what?
Jordan (Eng): I can own SLA text. Proposal: gradual target first 30d?
Sophie (SRE): +1. Propose Hosted API uptime 99.9%, p95 <=120ms, p99 <=350ms. Start with 1% canary for 48h.
Tom (Product Ops): Pricing: finance wants unit bands (low/med/high) and clear burst/overage policy. Need a one-pager to cite.
Ravi (Eng-ML): We plan auto-fallback to quantized model variants under pressure. Call out in SLA exceptions and compatibility note.
Maya (Support): I'll build runbooks and first-response playbook. Clarify breach notifications: enterprise = page, self-serve = email+ticket.
Elena (Docs): Checklist: quickstart, API contract, response schema, cost example, troubleshooting. Quickstart EOD, full docs in 48h.
Jordan (Eng): Draft SLA snippet to use in contracts and docs:
``
Hosted API SLA:
- Uptime: 99.9% monthly
- Latency SLOs: p95 <= 120ms, p99 <= 350ms
- Credits: prorated credits for monthly downtime >0.1%
- Exceptions: force majeure, planned maintenance (48h notice), routing to compatible variants
```
Sophie (SRE): Monitoring alerts: page when 5xx >0.5% over 5m, or p99 latency >500ms 3x in 15m. Attach traces to request-id.
Tom (Product Ops): Publish three tiers: Dev (pay-as-you-go), Team (committed monthly), Enterprise (reserved + SLA). I'll draft burst wording.
Ravi (Eng-ML): Note — quantized variants can regress on long-context hallucination; add mitigation steps and auto-fallback examples.
Elena (Docs): Will add compatibility table + example prompts showing regressions and mitigations.
Maya (Support): Oncall rota: weekday primary + weekend on-call. SRE pages only for infra incidents; Product Ops triage product incidents first. I'll add to playbook.
oncall-bot: deploy-notice: canary rollout started (1% traffic) — monitoring hooks active
Aisha (PM): Owners: Jordan -> SLA text; Sophie -> monitoring/playbooks; Maya -> runbooks+rota; Elena -> docs+compat table; Tom -> pricing+burst; Ravi -> variant note. Please ack. :thumbsup:
Jordan (Eng): ack
Sophie (SRE): ack
Maya (Support): ack
Elena (Docs): ack
Tom (Product Ops): ack
Ravi (Eng-ML): ack
Aisha (PM): I'll collate into final checklist and post to shiproom. Ping me directly if blockers. Thanks team :rocket:
